entities.name: Ali Eren Demirezen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ali Eren Demirezen is a Turkish professional boxer who held the WBO European heavyweight title from 2018 to 2019. As an amateur he won a silver medal at the 2013 Mediterranean Games in Mersin, Turkey.
